decisions.reason: Against the 2018 Academy of Management Proceedings version (Yu et al., 2018; 10.5465/AMBPP.2018.51), the replication is successful: Wismans et al. replicate both findings tested in Yu et al. (2018)—a positive association between hyperactivity and total EO and no association between attention-deficit and total EO—while total ADHD and EO subdimension analyses are new extensions. However, addressing the parent scope objection, the retained shipped original DOI (10.1177/1042258719892987) identifies the later Entrepreneurship Theory and Practice journal version (cited as Yu et al., 2020), which Footnote 1 explicitly calls a 'new version' that this replication was not based on; because the primary text never states what the journal version reported or whether its tested specifications and findings differed from the 2018 proceedings version, the outcome relative to the shipped journal article cannot be verified from primary evidence alone.
